issue.title: P2: build request-correlated UAV result delivery and truthful APP completion candidate
issue.body:
Process / workstream: P2 — causal APP service-completion candidate.
Deliverable: one reproducible full N=1 candidate composition in which successful completion means APP receives a fresh UAV detection result belonging to its own admitted request before its service deadline.
Atomic IDs: R02/R05/R06 supporting P2 composition work; no reassignment or closure. R07 remains the downstream responsibility of #80.
Owner: proposed vadimnbkg (existing authenticated account-id); unassigned until a separate implementation chat claims this Issue.
Independent reviewer / Integrator: proposed artmus208; appointment/acceptance is not implied.
Base ref: origin/read.
Exact implementation base: 91113a1b634f030c7e895f54f5c36a0b140d66eb (merged PR #79, remote read checked 2026-10-02).
Target branch: read.
Task branch after claim: codex/vadimnbkg/<issue-number>-uav-service-completion.

## Confirmed requirement and service deadline

On 2026-10-02 the user confirmed: success is APP receipt of a fresh UAV detection result for its request within the deadline. A grant, command ACK, elapsed global timer or termination event cannot substitute for this receipt.

Confirmed by the user on 2026-10-02 (recorded at 02:51:55 UTC): D_service = 40 model-time units, measured from the actual APP service_request emission and including admission and subsequent work. Timely receipt means request age <= 40; receipt after 40 cannot complete successfully. This is a relative service bound for the new candidate. The historical bus_T_complete=40 absolute trigger remains an immutable input, not the candidate completion condition. No physical-unit calibration is claimed.

Freshness is age of the actual sensing sample at APP receipt, not age of its notification or the newest unrelated global KPI. Preserve the existing strict UAV quality/update/freshness requirement predicates; document the exact class/age mapping and boundary equalities. Any additional numeric parameter must have explicit assumption/provenance.

## Problem and read-only inputs

The frozen N=1 composition has 50 automata. Boundary_E_SERVICE broadcasts service_complete at global time 40 and also after service_terminate. APP A_REQ accepts this broadcast from Accepted/AcceptedDegraded without a delivered-result guard. Shared queue service has no request-correlated result delivery. Consequently Completed does not establish the requested end-to-end success criterion.

Inputs:
- evidence/scalability/family-series-68/generated/n1/model.xml; SHA256 5234cb087e5274798926d516dedc77d1f9542ea7df59cec39f83859771ce1385.
- manifests/baselines/uav-family-r1.yaml; SHA256 5480bef5b00020735259f10eb43bdd9bc79ebc364a3bbcacad34c78fd0552cbf; family uav-family-r1-20260929.
- historical default baseline manifests/baselines/reviewer-r1.yaml selected by manifests/current.json; retain its separate scope.
- accepted limited P1/P2 decision in PR73#issuecomment-5890790922; family P4 activation PR75#issuecomment-5891123461; v2 activation #64. These decisions do not freeze or verify the new candidate.
- merged PR #79 / #78: actual engine replay reaches a shared grant at t=10 with APP still pending.
- optional read-only diagnostic context: draft PR #81 at dbc63cf92d2381040670b516cc6b11cd81a1639c shows a request rejection plus SLA violation report; not a successful result or an accepted dependency.
- src/uppaal_mcp/integrated/{adapt,boundary,generator}.py and family-series-68/generate.py for provenance.

Required dependencies for candidate preparation: merged historical family-preparation/activation packages #69/#73/#75 and diagnosis #79. PR #81 acceptance is not required for independently preparing this candidate. New P1/P2 acceptance and a new Gate 1 decision are required before downstream P3/P5 verification claims.

## Write scope and method

SOLE authorized write scope:
- evidence/instantiation/uav-service-completion-candidate/**

All other paths are read-only, including src/**, tests/**, existing family generators and generated XML, old evidence, manifests/** and levels_tex/samplepaper.tex. Place the deterministic transformer, tests, parameter contract, new XML, new query pack and evidence inside the sole directory. Use the exact historical full XML as a hash-checked compiler input and publish a separately identified candidate. Do not overwrite or relabel a frozen model.

This scope deliberately avoids source-path reservations in #30/#35/#36. Production-generator integration is a later separately scoped task after independent candidate review and any necessary scope transfer; this Issue does not release their reservations. The existing family generator compiles a frozen XML input: editing the integrated Python source alone would not alter that family.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Publish a small causal contract and deterministic generation command. Preserve the full N=1 PHY/MAC/SDN/APP composition; enumerate all changed templates, guards, assignments, synchronization channels, clocks and added instances. No reduced-model transfer claim.
2. Introduce bounded request/job correlation appropriate to the existing single-request abstraction. Bind request emission, accepted admission, an actual PHY detection/measurement event for the UAV job, its stored result and quality values, transmission work, and actual APP receipt. A healthy KPI snapshot alone is not a produced UAV detection result. Initial/default values, uncorrelated traffic, stale/duplicate events and unrelated grants cannot complete the request.
3. Couple result transmission to queue insertion and actual MAC eligibility/service; preserve capacity and overflow semantics. Distinguish scheduling/grant, attempted transmission, any applicable command ACK and actual delivery. Preserve a failure/loss branch; receipt cannot be assigned unconditionally when a grant occurs.
4. Completed requires admitted matching request, matching received sample/result, consistent sensing quality satisfying the strict APP request, sample age satisfying freshness at receipt, and request age <= D_service. Do not evaluate stored payload quality using later unrelated global KPI values. Record completion ages on receipt rather than allowing clocks in terminal locations to invalidate a retrospective success claim.
5. Replace the timer/termination completion shortcut. Add explicit timeout/failure/cancel outcomes that cannot set a successful-completion flag. Record whether admission failure and service failure are separate outcomes. Prevent completion after rejection, cancellation or expiry; preserve existing admission-loss/timeout and safety downgrade policies.
6. Reset the service clock only on actual APP request emission; reset sample age only on the actual matching sensing measurement. Specify deadline and freshness equality behavior. Bound invariants/timeout transitions must allow failure rather than introduce an artificial time lock; inspect committed/urgent behavior.
7. Add meaningful regression controls for early fake completion, wrong request/sample, stale result, failed sensing, grant without delivery, missing/late delivery, cancellation and deadline equality. Include a healthy matching timely case. Static checks establish structure only.
8. Publish exact success-reachability and completion-safety queries plus non-vacuity controls. A directed UPPAAL engine witness/replay must audit every step of the healthy causal chain and terminal state; engine-confirmed simulation and exhaustive query verdicts remain distinct. A witness does not establish universal completion/fairness. A timeout remains open.
9. Before native execution checkpoint the candidate and record an executable bounded protocol: exact model/query/source hashes, commands, actual tool version, unique run IDs, per-cell/total time and memory caps, fresh resource checks, raw output/trace and cleanup. No budget transfer, rerun or semantic-evidence transfer from #78/#80. Failed/incomplete runs remain visible. Each model configuration has its own model hash/run IDs.
10. Run relevant CONTRIBUTING tests/checks and scoped regressions; publish a clean named branch and PR to read with exact HEAD/base, scope audit and durable branch/bundle handoff. Reviewer decides acceptance; author does not freeze a baseline or close R07.

Expected outputs under the sole scope: contract.md, parameter/provenance records, deterministic candidate generator, full model.xml, instance/interface inventories, query pack, causal trace/evidence index, regression tests and HANDOFF.md. Exact filenames may vary.

Evidence class: changed-model candidate + static validation + separately recorded engine simulation/model-checking evidence when actually executed.
No automatic transfer of old verification results. New baseline activation/freeze needs a governance Issue with manifest-specific scope. The numerical deadline is confirmed. The one-Issue-per-chat rule requires implementation in a separate chat assigned to this Issue.

Status: ready for claim in a separate implementation chat. The deadline clarification is complete; no implementation has started. The new chat must recheck dependencies, current open scopes, input hashes and the exact pinned base before claiming. This Issue records the discovered problem and concrete handoff; no automata have been changed by its creation.

## Решение об активации v2

По прямому поручению пользователя / Integrator в текущей сессии: «Запишем активацию», фиксируется активация scientific plan `manifests/v2.md` и coordination contract `manifests/collaboration-v2.yaml` через `manifests/current.json` для новых задач в `read`.

- **Operational guide:** `CONTRIBUTING-v2.md`.
- **Baseline:** `manifests/baselines/reviewer-r1.yaml`, `reviewer-r1-gate1-20260923`.
- **Migration map:** `manifests/v2-migration.md`.
- **Open-issue mapping:** [evidence/governance/20260928-v2-activation/open-issues-map.json](https://github.com/artmus208/uppaal_sdn_isac/blob/05ac107789532b6d2eac9914433a4b8408835057/evidence/governance/20260928-v2-activation/open-issues-map.json).

**Scope:** operational coordination only. Исторические generation inputs, baseline, evidence и прежние scientific acceptance records сохраняются в исходной области. Эта запись не принимает новые научные gates, не закрывает P3 и не меняет ownership, write scopes или обязательные зависимости существующих Issues. Для новых задач действует v2, включая принцип обоснованного компромисса и открытой неопределённости в пределах выбранного бюджета.

Проверены фактические merge/approval и содержимое pointer/contract на указанном merge commit. Head PR совпадает с ранее проверенным `6f9e5e08df33fdbd52aed0d36c4b2f1ed15b4817`; [CI успешен](https://github.com/artmus208/uppaal_sdn_isac/actions/runs/36478079073). Ранее сохранены 200 успешных tests и audit 57 file hashes без расхождений. Новые model-checking runs не выполнялись.

Deliverable #64 принят в указанной governance-области; условия активации выполнены. Issue можно закрыть как completed.

## Решение Integrator: A/B и применимость P1/P2
Зафиксировано 2026-09-29 после явного решения пользователя/Integrator в текущей сессии:
> Подтверждаю A/B и применимость P1/P2 в этой ограниченной области

Recorded by: vadimnbkg (запись решения пользователя, не самостоятельная приёмка автором).

Принятый пакет: PR #73, HEAD c439b0811c8f0063ee44e968587d08a46361b4b4; merge в read 939ccbcba8d6d3381eb4c4288a0cd6de432dfd2d.
Исходная база пакета: read, 52c5c8d94122f5fbd2a7b689fd9e764583de3226.
Точные входы и hashes: [baseline-candidate.json](https://github.com/artmus208/uppaal_sdn_isac/blob/c439b0811c8f0063ee44e968587d08a46361b4b4/evidence/governance/family-gate1-20260929/baseline-candidate.json), [input-hashes.json](https://github.com/artmus208/uppaal_sdn_isac/blob/c439b0811c8f0063ee44e968587d08a46361b4b4/evidence/governance/family-gate1-20260929/input-hashes.json).
Идентификатор для последующей фиксации: uav-family-r1-20260929.

**A — ACCEPTED:** точное конечное семейство N=1,2,3,4 (50/99/148/197 автоматов) принято для последующей фиксации baseline. Сохранены абстрактные параметры, один общий необязательный выбор обслуживания за эпоху, частные SDN-контексты, observers и известные ограничения. Это приёмка объекта исследования, не истинности формул.

**P1/P2 applicability — ACCEPTED в ограниченной области:** применимы сохранённые методика, абстрактные единицы/классы/параметры и описание частных компонентов/интерфейсов вместе с расширением композиции #68/#69 и ограничениями из follow-up в Issue #72. Эмпирическая калибровка, внешняя validation, whole-system timed equivalence и автоматический перенос P3 не принимаются. Изменение SharedLoad и последовательности уведомлений явно учтено; структурные/локальные проверки не становятся model checking.

**B — ACCEPTED:** допустимая область будущего P4 — затраты запусков verifier на точных полных моделях и запросах при заданных условиях/лимитах. Завершённые проверки и прерванные по лимитам наблюдения учитываются отдельно. Достижимость обслуживания остаётся OPEN. Нет выводов о работоспособности сети, полезной пропускной способности, fairness, SLA или универсальной queue safety. R03/R04/C06 автоматически не закрываются.

Исторический Gate 1 reviewer-r1-gate1-20260923 сохраняется.
Данное решение снимает ожидание A/B и applicability; прежние пометки «awaiting decision» в proposal — историческое состояние до этого решения.
Операционная фиксация/активация нового baseline требует отдельного governance Issue с manifest-specific scope и проверки совместимости выбора baseline. Этот комментарий не утверждает завершение такой активации.
P4 execution authorization: NOT GRANTED; нужен отдельный Issue и принятый протокол исполнения. Новых запусков UPPAAL нет.
